view_title: Column grid master for บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 7 (แบบบ้านสานฝัน S59030) -- derived from S-02 แปลนฐานรากแผ่ (PNG 24 / printed 22), cross-checked on S-03/S-04/S-05/A-04. 4 x 6 named grid, 9.60 m x 14.55 m overall, plus 5 dummy x-lines and 2 dummy y-lines.

x_lines.source: S-04/S-05 (free west end of the E-D veranda band: B2X beams from grids E-1/D-1 end on a B1 + 2 CN posts). pos printed as '1.00' west of grid 1 on A-04's top chain and again on A-11's WC.1 enlargement chain ('1.00 | grid 1 | 1.80'). S-05 separately prints '1.10' = distance to the beam's OUTER face (beam is 0.20 wide, centreline -1.00, outer face -1.10) -- not a conflict, two different reference faces.

S-04 (dashed B1 under-slab beam E-D at 1.80, east wall of bathroom WC.1). pos printed '1.80' on A-11 WC.1 enlargement chain ('1.00 | grid 1 | 1.80'). Pixel-verified 1.800 m on S-04 (78.75 px/m calibration).

S-05 (vertical RB1 ring beam E-D mid bay 2-3, with column CX at 0.80 m below row E). pos printed '1.60' west of grid 3 on S-05 => 6.40 - 1.60 = 4.80. Exists at ring-beam level only; S-04 floor level has no member here (verified by pixel scan).

S-04 (dashed B1 under-slab beam E-D at 7.80, west wall of bathroom WC.2 -- mirror of 1''). pos printed '1.80' west of grid 4 on A-13 WC.2 enlargement chain ('1.80 | grid 4 | 1.00') => 9.60 - 1.80 = 7.80. Pixel-verified 7.797 m on S-04.

S-04/S-05 (free east end of the E-D veranda band, mirror of 1'). pos printed '1.00' east of grid 4 on A-04's top chain and on A-13's WC.2 chain. S-05's mirrored '1.10' is again the outer-face figure. Pixel-verified 10.597 m on S-04.

y_lines.source: printed chain 4.00+2.00+3.60+1.80+3.15 = 14.55 on S-02/S-03/S-04/S-05/A-04 (topmost main grid = origin per schema §4)

S-04 (dashed B1 under-slab beam across bay 1-2 only, south edge of the S1 strip below row F). pos printed '0.90' on A-04's left chain (0.90 + 3.10 = 4.00 closes to row E). Pixel-verified 0.90 m on S-04.

S-05 (hidden ring beam RB1A+3.65 spanning grids 3-4, front edge of the carport roof). pos printed '2.50' on S-05 measured up from row A => 14.55 - 2.50 = 12.05. Exists at ring/roof level only; S-04 floor level has no beam here.

warnings: BOTH DIMENSION CHAINS CLOSE EXACTLY. x-axis: 3.20 + 3.20 + 3.20 = 9.60 m = the printed overall '9.60' (verified at 4.5x zoom on S-02, identical chain repeats on S-03/S-04/S-05/A-04). y-axis: 4.00 (F-E) + 2.00 (E-D) + 3.60 (D-C) + 1.80 (C-B) + 3.15 (B-A) = 14.55 m = the printed overall '14.55' (same verification). Pixel geometry agrees with the printed chains at a uniform 78.75 px/m on both axes across S-02/S-04 -- every measured grid spacing lands within 1 px of the printed value, which is itself an independent no-hidden-break check.

NO DRAWING BREAK LINES anywhere in this set's plan/structural sheets. Checked explicitly per the house-06 lesson: tight crops at 4.5x on the mid-segments of both overall dimension lines and the long open grid-line runs of S-02 (F-E 4.00 m gap, D-C 3.60 m gap, both 3.20 m x-bays) show continuous straight lines with no zigzag symbol; S-03/S-04/S-05/A-04 use the identical CAD template and were examined at zoom during extraction with the same result. This is a clean 2559-era CAD set at 1:100 -- the whole 9.60 x 14.55 building fits the sheet without breaks. CAUTION for later stages: the one-way-slab DIRECTION ARROWS on S-04 (thin horizontal line with a small zigzag hook at each end, one per slab bay) superficially resemble a break-line zigzag at low zoom -- they are span-direction symbols, not breaks.

STAGE-0 FLAG RESOLVED (reversal recorded): the Stage 0 manifest flagged '2 extra footings F0.80x0.80 / pile caps, mark C1A, OFF-GRID between grid 2-3 near row A/B' and asked for dummy grids. High-zoom crops (4.5x) of S-02 and S-03 show FOUR C1A footings, not two, and all four sit EXACTLY ON grid intersections -- B-2, B-3 (row B) and A-3, A-4 (row A); the grid dash-dot lines pass through the centre of each hatched column stub, and no local offset dimensions are printed anywhere near them (none are needed). No dummy grid was created for them. Stage 0's low-zoom read mistook the sparse B/A rows (2 footings each instead of 4) for an off-grid cluster.

DUMMY-GRID NAMING DECISION: 7 dummy lines were found via the schema §4 beam-endpoint rule. Naming follows the established precedent (houses 01/03/04) that an in-gap dummy takes the prime of the main grid on its LEFT/ABOVE (house 01 named the line at 2.55 in gap 1-2 '1\'' even though grid 2 was nearer), and a dummy before the origin keeps the origin at the first named grid and goes NEGATIVE (schema §4 example, house 03's 1' at -1.10, house 04's E' at -1.90). Hence: 1' = -1.00 (before origin), 1'' = 1.80 (same base '1', scan order left-to-right keeps 1' left of 1'' as §4 requires), 2' = 4.80, 3' = 7.80, 4' = 10.60, F' = 0.90, B' = 12.05. First real case of a house needing both a before-origin dummy and an in-gap dummy on the same base grid.

1.10 vs 1.00 RECONCILIATION (the only inter-sheet dimension disagreement found): S-05 prints '1.10' for the E-D band extension beyond grids 1/4 while A-04 and A-11/A-13 print '1.00'. Not a conflict -- pixel measurement shows one physical line: beam/CN-post CENTRELINE at 1.00 m (matching A-04/A-11/A-13 and the S-04/S-05 drawn geometry, both sheets draw the beam at the same pixels), with S-05's 1.10 measured to the beam's OUTER FACE (0.20 m wide beam: 1.00 + 0.10). Grid lines run through member centrelines, so 1'/4' are set at -1.00/10.60. 3 sheets agree on the centreline figure vs 1 sheet printing the face figure.

SLAB-ONLY EDGES DELIBERATELY NOT GIVEN DUMMY GRIDS (schema §4 conversely-rule): (a) the S0 apron/ramp south edge 1.60 m below row A (printed 1.60 on A-04) -- single-line slab-on-ground edge, no beam, no columns; (b) the ซักล้าง laundry slab and ST2 step strip north of row F (locally dimensioned 0.60/0.40/2.70/0.20 on A-04) -- ground-supported, S-04 shows only tread/edge lines there, no beam; (c) the แนวหลังคา roof outline dashed rectangle on A-04 (roof plans A-05/S-06 are Stage 2 scope). The CX column at (x 4.80, 0.80 m below row E, printed '0.80' on S-05) is a point element mid-beam -- recorded on the S-05 plan file with an offset note, no y-dummy warranted since no beam ends at that y.

Row letters run A (south/bottom) to F (north/top); origin (0,0) is set at F-1 (topmost/leftmost main grid per schema §4), pos_m increasing downward/rightward -- same orientation convention as sibling house 02 (บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_02), whose grid master this house's named grid matches line-for-line (same series template). This master was still derived 100% from house 04's own sheets, not copied.

Main-grid footing coverage is NOT a full 4 x 6: rows F/E/D/C carry footings at all four columns; row B only at B-2/B-3 and row A only at A-3/A-4 (all four = the lighter C1A columns under the porch and carport roofs). Grid intersections B-1, B-4, A-1, A-2 have no structure on any sheet read.
